@@elio crontab
# /etc/crontab: system-wide crontab
# Unlike any other crontab you don't have to run the `crontab'
# command to install the new version when you edit this file
# and files in /etc/cron.d. These files also have username fields,
# that none of the other crontabs do.

SHELL=/bin/sh
# You can also override PATH, but by default, newer versions inherit it from the environment
#PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/sbin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin

# Example of job definition:
# .---------------- minute (0 - 59)
# |  .------------- hour (0 - 23)
# |  |  .---------- day of month (1 - 31)
# |  |  |  .------- month (1 - 12) OR jan,feb,mar,apr ...
# |  |  |  |  .---- day of week (0 - 6) (Sunday=0 or 7) OR sun,mon,tue,wed,thu,fri,sat
# |  |  |  |  |
# *  *  *  *  * user-name command to be executed
17 *	* * *	root	cd / && run-parts --report /etc/cron.hourly
25 6	* * *	root	test -x /usr/sbin/anacron || { cd / && run-parts --report /etc/cron.daily; }
47 6	* * 7	root	test -x /usr/sbin/anacron || { cd / && run-parts --report /etc/cron.weekly; }
52 6	1 * *	root	test -x /usr/sbin/anacron || { cd / && run-parts --report /etc/cron.monthly; }
#
@@elio cron.d
@@file /etc/cron.d/e2scrub_all
30 3 * * 0 root test -e /run/systemd/system || SERVICE_MODE=1 /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/e2fsprogs/e2scrub_all_cron
10 3 * * * root test -e /run/systemd/system || SERVICE_MODE=1 /sbin/e2scrub_all -A -r
@@file /etc/cron.d/pg-backup
MAILTO=ops@example.com
# Nightly dump of every database
15 2 * * * postgres /usr/local/bin/backup.sh --all >> /var/log/pg-backup.log 2>&1
@@elio periodic
daily apt-compat
daily dpkg
daily logrotate
daily man-db
weekly man-db
@@elio users
@@file root
# DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE - edit the master and reinstall.
*/5 * * * * /root/bin/check-disk.sh
@reboot /root/bin/warmup.sh
@@file deploy
0 */6 * * * cd /srv/app && ./bin/rails runner 'Cleanup.run' >/dev/null
@@elio timers
Id=apt-daily-upgrade.timer
Description=Daily apt upgrade and clean activities
Unit=apt-daily-upgrade.service
ActiveState=active
UnitFileState=enabled
TimersCalendar={ OnCalendar=*-*-* 06:00:00 ; next_elapse=@1762059600 }
LastTriggerUSec=@1761973203
NextElapseUSecRealtime=@1762060117
ServiceResult=success
ServiceExecMainStatus=0

Id=certbot.timer
Description=Run certbot twice daily
Unit=certbot.service
ActiveState=active
UnitFileState=enabled
TimersCalendar={ OnCalendar=*-*-* 00,12:00:00 ; next_elapse=@1762041600 }
LastTriggerUSec=@1761998400
NextElapseUSecRealtime=@1762042511
ServiceResult=exit-code
ServiceExecMainStatus=1

Id=backup.timer
Description=Offsite backup
Unit=backup.service
ActiveState=active
UnitFileState=enabled
TimersCalendar={ OnCalendar=*-*-* 03:00:00 ; next_elapse=@1762048800 }
LastTriggerUSec=@1761703200
NextElapseUSecRealtime=@1762048800
ServiceResult=success
ServiceExecMainStatus=0

Id=systemd-tmpfiles-clean.timer
Description=Daily Cleanup of Temporary Directories
Unit=systemd-tmpfiles-clean.service
ActiveState=active
UnitFileState=static
TimersMonotonic={ OnBootUSec=15min ; next_elapse=0 }
TimersMonotonic={ OnUnitActiveUSec=1d ; next_elapse=1d 15min }
LastTriggerUSec=@1761980000
NextElapseUSecRealtime=
ServiceResult=success
ServiceExecMainStatus=0

Id=fstrim.timer
Description=Discard unused filesystem blocks once a week
Unit=fstrim.service
ActiveState=inactive
UnitFileState=disabled
TimersCalendar={ OnCalendar=Mon *-*-* 00:00:00 ; next_elapse=n/a }
LastTriggerUSec=n/a
NextElapseUSecRealtime=n/a
ServiceResult=success
ServiceExecMainStatus=0
